title: The Fall of Constantinople and the Rise of the West,
title_zh: 君士坦丁堡的陷落与西方的崛起
title_primary: 君士坦丁堡的陷落与西方的崛起
title_secondary: The Fall of Constantinople and the Rise of the West,
authors: Andreas Link
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Renaissance era in Western Europe was marked by a flourishing of economic and cultural life that gave rise to numerous discoveries and inventions. This paper studies the role played by Greek knowledge in this process. Using a newly constructed dataset on Greek migrants in Europe after the fall of Constantinople in 1453, I show that a Greek presence in the second half of the fifteenth century increased city growth in the sixteenth century. In terms of mechanisms, I find that a Greek presence increased the available knowledge stock in astronomy, mathematics, medicine, and humanistic subjects – fields in which ancient Greek and Byzantine knowledge was especially advanced. Finally, I document an increase in upper-tail human capital and inventions in these cities. My findings thus show the important role played by Greek migrants in disseminating knowledge and the positive impact that Greek knowledge exerted on city growth in the early modern period.

title: Macroeconomic dynamics of the output floor
title_zh: 产出下限的宏观经济动态
title_primary: 产出下限的宏观经济动态
title_secondary: Macroeconomic dynamics of the output floor
authors: Jonathan Acosta-Smith & Marzio Bassanin & Ivy Sabuga
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We assess the macroeconomic effects of the output floor, a new regulatory constraint introduced as part of the Basel III framework. The output floor is designed to provide a backstop against excessively low risk-weighted assets (RWA) modelled by banks relative to the riskiness of the underlying exposures. Our model shows that it counteracts the downward pressure on modelled RWA during economic expansions and, in turn, reduces the cyclicality of risk-weighted capital requirements. This mitigates increases in the credit-to-GDP ratio and supports the objectives of the macroprudential authority. Our analysis also uncovers important sectoral effects. Estimating the model for the UK economy, we find that during an expansion the output floor dampens the growth of mortgage lending but amplifies the expansion of lending to firms, although the latter effect is more than offset by the former.

title: Elite auditor and audit pricing
title_zh: 精英审计师与审计定价
title_primary: 精英审计师与审计定价
title_secondary: Elite auditor and audit pricing
authors: Yingchen Guo, Chan Lyu, Shaohua Tian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Audit pricing remains a black box due to the opaque fee negotiations and the credence nature of audit services. Focusing on auditors’ elite educational backgrounds as a salient human capital signal, this study investigates the economic returns to educational prestige in China’s audit market. The results show that auditors with elite university degrees are associated with higher audit fees. The association attenuates substantially after controlling client fixed effects, indicating that part of the baseline premium reflects auditor-client matching. The association is amplified in less concentrated markets and among non-Big 4 firms. This premium is stronger in state-owned enterprises and intensifies following the 2013 special general partnership reform. This study extends signalling theory by delineating the organizational, market, and institutional boundaries that govern the human capital valuation in emerging audit market. KEYWORDS: Signing auditors elite education audit pricing audit firm JEL CLASSIFICATION: M40 M42
abstract_zh: 审计定价因费用谈判的不透明性及审计服务的信任品特性，始终是一个“黑箱”。本研究聚焦于签字审计师的名校教育背景作为显著的人力资本信号，探讨在中国审计市场中教育声望的经济回报。研究发现，拥有精英大学学位的审计师与更高的审计费用相关联。在控制客户固定效应后，这一关联显著减弱，表明基线溢价部分反映了审计师与客户之间的匹配效应。该关联在竞争程度较低的市场及非“四大”事务所中更为显著。此外，这一溢价在国有企业中表现更强，并在2013年特殊普通合伙制改革后有所加剧。本研究通过界定新兴审计市场中影响人力资本估值的组织、市场及制度边界，拓展了信号传递理论。关键词：签字审计师；精英教育；审计定价；审计事务所 JEL分类：M40；M42

title: The unintended real effect of salary history bans: The case of innovation
title_zh: 薪酬历史禁令的意外实际效应：以创新为例
title_primary: 薪酬历史禁令的意外实际效应：以创新为例
title_secondary: The unintended real effect of salary history bans: The case of innovation
authors: Julian Atanassov, Lin Deng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper documents that firms experience a decline in innovation following the staggered adoption of salary history ban legislation (SHBs), which prohibits employers from asking job candidates about salary histories in the hiring process. We develop a theoretical model and hypothesize that SHBs impose higher informational asymmetries in the labor market and thus cause more severe adverse selection when employers attempt to hire inventors. Consistent with this hypothesis, we find that after SHBs, firms hire fewer inventors relative to their total workforce and, at the firm-year level, the newly hired inventor pool exhibits lower average innovation performance. Inventor-level tests further show that firms become more selective among the inventors they do hire. We also show that the adverse effect of SHBs on innovation is more pronounced for firms in states with stronger labor market protection. This paper outlines the unintended consequences of labor regulation and information restriction on corporate innovation.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了在逐步实施薪资历史禁令立法（SHBs）后，企业创新活动出现下滑的现象。该立法禁止雇主在招聘过程中询问求职者的薪资历史。我们构建了一个理论模型，并提出假设：SHBs加剧了劳动力市场中的信息不对称，从而在雇主试图招聘发明家时引发更严重的逆向选择问题。与这一假设相符的是，我们发现实施SHBs后，企业相对于其总员工规模招聘的发明家数量减少，并且在企业-年度层面上，新招聘的发明家群体的平均创新绩效较低。发明家层面的测试进一步表明，企业在实际招聘的发明家中变得更加挑剔。我们还发现，SHBs对创新的不利影响在劳动力市场保护更强的州份企业中更为显著。本文揭示了劳动法规与信息限制对企业创新的意外后果。

title: Understanding Latin America’s Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
title_zh: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态
title_primary: 理解拉丁美洲生育率下降：年龄、教育与队列动态
title_secondary: Understanding Latin America’s Fertility Decline: Age, Education, and Cohort Dynamics
authors: Inés Berniell, Raquel Fernández, Azul Menduiña, Milagros Onofri
official: 官方在线 2026-01-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the sharp decline in fertility across Latin America using both period and cohort measures. Combining Vital Statistics, Census microdata, and UN population data, we decompose changes in fertility by age, education, and joint age–education groups. We show that the decline in period fertility between 2000 and 2022 is driven primarily by reductions in within-group birth rates rather than by changes in population composition, with the largest contributions coming from younger and less-educated women. Comparing the cohort born in the mid 1950s and the one born in the mid 1970s, we find that the decline in completed fertility reflects not only delayed childbearing but also substantial reductions in the average number of children per woman. This is driven primarily by lower fertility among mothers rather than by rising childlessness. Our findings provide new evidence on the nature of Latin America’s transition to below-replacement fertility and highlight several open questions for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文运用时期与队列两种度量方式，考察了拉丁美洲生育率的急剧下降现象。结合生命统计、人口普查微观数据及联合国人口数据，我们按年龄、教育程度及年龄-教育联合组别对生育率变化进行了分解。研究显示，2000年至2022年间时期生育率的下降主要源于组内生育率的降低，而非人口构成的变化，其中年轻且受教育程度较低的女性贡献最大。对比1950年代中期与1970年代中期出生的队列，我们发现完成生育率的下降不仅反映了生育延迟，还体现了每位女性平均子女数量的显著减少。这一变化主要由已育女性的生育率降低驱动，而非无子女现象的增加。我们的研究为拉丁美洲向低于更替水平生育率转变的性质提供了新证据，并指出了未来研究中若干待解的问题。

title: ECB Exchange Rate Communication
title_zh: 欧洲央行汇率沟通
title_primary: 欧洲央行汇率沟通
title_secondary: ECB Exchange Rate Communication
authors: Mar Domenech Palacios, Michael Ehrmann, Arnaud Mehl, Massimo Ferrari Minesso, Fabio Comazzi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We revisit the debate on the effectiveness of central bank communication on exchange rates, contrasting a skeptical view, which holds that communication neither moves exchange rates nor influences them in the desired direction, with an optimistic view that it does. Using nearly 100 official ECB statements on exchange rates made during its monetary policy press conferences since 2002, we show that the ECB tends to mention the exchange rate when the real effective exchange rate deviates from its equilibrium value, whereas journalists' questions are mainly responsive to the nominal exchange rate. Studying the effects of these mentions, our findings by and large support the skeptical view: after controlling for monetary policy shocks, exchange rate communication has limited immediate effects on the euro exchange rate, which fade quickly. Effectiveness is particularly limited when interest rates are at their effective lower bound.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视关于中央银行沟通对汇率有效性的辩论，对比了两种观点：一种持怀疑态度，认为沟通既不能推动汇率变动，也不能引导其朝预期方向发展；另一种则持乐观态度，认为沟通确实有效。基于自2002年以来欧洲央行在货币政策新闻发布会上发布的近100份关于汇率的官方声明，我们发现，当实际有效汇率偏离其均衡值时，欧洲央行倾向于提及汇率问题，而记者的提问则主要针对名义汇率。研究这些提及的影响，我们的发现大体上支持怀疑观点：在控制货币政策冲击后，汇率沟通对欧元汇率的即时影响有限，且这种影响迅速消退。尤其在利率触及有效下限时，其有效性更为受限。

title_primary: 根深蒂固的政治王朝与竞争性庇护制下的发展：来自巴基斯坦的证据
title_secondary: Entrenched Political Dynasties and Development Under Competitive Clientelism: Evidence from Pakistan
authors: Rinchan Mirza, Adeel Malik, Jean-Philippe Platteau, Fernanda Ortega, Dennis Snower 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we estimate the impact of entrenched political dynasties on local development in Pakistan’s largest province, Punjab. Toward this purpose, we compile an original database on political genealogies, which includes information about the personal and family characteristics of both elected representatives and the main contenders in elections for the last one hundred years covering both elections held under colonial rule and Pakistan’s modern political existence. Three main findings emerge. First, entrenched political dynasties are historical families whose influence dates back to the colonial period. Second, using a close elections regression discontinuity design, we show that historical families have a worse development impact than non-historic families. Third, based on complementary surveys, we argue that segmented political markets simultaneously account for the long-term persistence of historic families and their negative development impact under conditions of competitive clientelism.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了根深蒂固的政治王朝对巴基斯坦最大省份旁遮普省地方发展的影响。为此，我们编制了一个关于政治谱系的原创数据库，其中包含了过去一百年间，在殖民统治下及巴基斯坦现代政治存在期间举行的选举中，当选代表及主要竞争者的个人及家庭特征信息。研究得出三个主要发现。第一，根深蒂固的政治王朝是历史悠久的家族，其影响力可追溯至殖民时期。第二，利用接近选举的断点回归设计，我们表明历史家族对发展的影响不如非历史家族。第三，基于补充调查，我们认为，在竞争性庇护主义条件下，分割的政治市场同时解释了历史家族的长期延续及其对发展的负面影响。

title: Uncertain Climate Policy and Activist Investing
title_zh: 不确定的气候政策与积极投资者投资
title_primary: 不确定的气候政策与积极投资者投资
title_secondary: Uncertain Climate Policy and Activist Investing
authors: Caiquan Bai, Bangru Shi, Siqi Zhao, Zhentao Zou
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of sustainable investment in which emission-based government regulation simultaneously stimulates green investment and creates policy-induced transition risk. A novel market failure emerges: policy uncertainty generates both financial value and pro-social values for emission mitigation, but firms internalize only the financial benefits and therefore underinvest in mitigation, triggering the emission rebound effect. Investor activism can alleviate this distortion and incentivize green investment. Hence, activism reduces the need for aggressive policy intervention. This substitution effect is weakened by advisory costs but strengthened by green innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于可持续投资的动态理论，其中基于排放的政府监管同时刺激绿色投资并产生政策引发的转型风险。一种新颖的市场失灵现象浮现：政策不确定性既为减排带来财务价值，也带来亲社会价值，但企业仅内化财务收益，因此对减排投资不足，引发排放反弹效应。投资者积极主义能够缓解这一扭曲并激励绿色投资。因此，积极主义降低了对激进政策干预的需求。这种替代效应因咨询成本而减弱，但会因绿色创新而增强。

title: Safe debt financing: International spillovers and the benefits of fiscal policy coordination
title_zh: 安全债务融资：国际溢出效应与财政政策协调的收益
title_primary: 安全债务融资：国际溢出效应与财政政策协调的收益
title_secondary: Safe debt financing: International spillovers and the benefits of fiscal policy coordination
authors: Matthias Gnewuch, Matthieu Bellon, Luca Zavalloni
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Safe government bonds enjoy a discount known as the convenience yield. When a government issues more debt, it erodes this discount for itself and for other countries – a fiscal externality that incentivises excessive debt issuance. But safe asset issuers also have market power, and thus incentives to reduce issuance to boost the convenience yield and extract rents from foreign bondholders. This column studies these distortions under non-cooperative fiscal policy. Over the past decade, the fiscal externality has dominated in the euro area, fostering over-issuance of safe sovereign debt. This calls for fiscal coordination and restraint even absent debt sustainability concerns.
abstract_zh: 安全政府债券享有被称为便利收益的折扣。当政府发行更多债务时，它会侵蚀自身及其他国家的这一折扣——这是一种财政外部性，激励过度债务发行。然而，安全资产发行者也拥有市场力量，因此有动机减少发行以提高便利收益，并从外国债券持有者那里获取租金。本专栏在非合作财政政策下研究这些扭曲。过去十年中，财政外部性在欧元区占据主导地位，促进了安全主权债务的过度发行。这要求即便在没有债务可持续性担忧的情况下，也应进行财政协调与克制。

title: Climate policy may crowd out green values and what to do about it
title_zh: 气候政策可能挤出绿色价值观及其应对之策
title_primary: 气候政策可能挤出绿色价值观及其应对之策
title_secondary: Climate policy may crowd out green values and what to do about it
authors: Katrin Schmelz, Samuel Bowles
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Conventional approaches to policy design fail to recognise the plasticity of citizens’ beliefs and social preferences. Based on a representative sample from Germany, this column shows that mandated carbon-reducing lifestyle changes such as limiting heating and the use of cars in city centres may crowd out pre-existing green values. Effective climate policy design requires recognising that (a) to succeed, essential policies including bans, carbon taxes, and the promotion of new technologies must be both implementable and politically sustainable, entailing (b) a critical role for citizens’ green values, which (c) may be either diminished or cultivated, depending on policy design.
abstract_zh: 传统的政策设计方法未能认识到公民信念和社会偏好的可塑性。基于德国代表性样本，本专栏指出，诸如限制供暖和市中心汽车使用等强制性的碳减排生活方式改变，可能会挤出既有的绿色价值观。有效的气候政策设计需认识到：（a）要取得成功，包括禁令、碳税及新技术推广在内的关键政策必须既可行又具有政治可持续性，这要求（b）公民的绿色价值观发挥关键作用，而（c）这些价值观可能因政策设计的不同而被削弱或培育。

authors: Thierry Verdier, James A. Robinson, Ragnar Torvik, Oliver Vanden Eynde, Juan Vargas 等
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this Paper we argue that the political incentives that resource endowments generate are the key to understanding whether or not they are a curse. We show: (1) politicians tend to over-extract natural resources relative to the efficient extraction path because they discount the future too much; (2) resource booms improve the efficiency of the extraction path; (3) resource booms, however, by raising the value of being in power and by providing politicians with more resources which they can use to influence the outcome of elections, increase resource misallocation in the rest of the economy and (4) the overall impact of resource booms on the economy depends critically on institutions, since these determine the extent to which political incentives map into policy outcomes. Countries with good institutions tend to benefit from resource booms since these institutions mitigate the perverse political incentives that such booms create. Countries with bad institutions suffer a resource curse.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，资源禀赋所产生的政治激励是理解其是否成为“诅咒”的关键。我们论证：（1）政治家倾向于过度开采自然资源，偏离有效开采路径，因为他们对未来过度折现；（2）资源繁荣会改善开采路径的效率；（3）然而，资源繁荣通过提升执政价值，并为政治家提供更多可用于影响选举结果的资源，加剧了经济其他领域的资源错配；（4）资源繁荣对经济的总体影响关键取决于制度，因为制度决定了政治激励转化为政策结果的程度。制度良好的国家往往能从资源繁荣中受益，因为这些制度缓解了繁荣所引发的扭曲性政治激励。制度不良的国家则会遭受资源诅咒。

title: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
title_zh: 资源保护中的溢出效应检验：来自自然田野实验的证据
title_primary: 资源保护中的溢出效应检验：来自自然田野实验的证据
title_secondary: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
authors: Lorenz F. Goette, Z. H. Lim
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies whether behavioral interventions designed to promote resource conservation in one domain generate spillovers in another. Using a natural field experiment involving over 2,000 residents, we identify the direct and spillover effects of real-time feedback and social comparisons on water and energy consumption. We implement three interventions: two targeting shower use and one targeting air-conditioning use. We find significant reductions in shower use from both water-saving interventions, but no direct effect of the energy-saving intervention on air-conditioning use. For spillovers, we estimate precise null effects of water-saving interventions on air-conditioning use, and of the energy-saving intervention on shower use.
abstract_zh: 本文研究旨在促进某一领域资源节约的行为干预措施是否会在另一领域产生溢出效应。通过一项涉及2000多名居民的自然实地实验，我们识别了实时反馈与社会比较对水和能源消耗的直接效应及溢出效应。我们实施了三种干预措施：两种针对淋浴用水，一种针对空调用电。研究发现，两种节水干预措施均显著减少了淋浴用水，但节能干预措施对空调用电无直接效应。在溢出效应方面，我们估计出节水干预措施对空调用电以及节能干预措施对淋浴用水的精确零效应。

title: 身份筹划的避税效应：增值税纳税人身份选择与税负变动
title_zh: 身份筹划的避税效应：增值税纳税人身份选择与税负变动
title_primary: 身份筹划的避税效应：增值税纳税人身份选择与税负变动
authors: 李媛, 储德银
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 理清增值税纳税人身份选择行为的微观形成机理,对于提高税收征管效率、维护企业税负公平以及保障增值税收入稳定增长等具有重要意义。本文采用聚束（bunching）方法研究增值税纳税人身份选择行为对企业增值税实际税负的影响,并对小规模纳税人“拒绝长大”的形成原因及实现路径进行讨论。研究表明,相对于转为一般纳税人的小规模纳税人而言,实施纳税身份筹划的小规模纳税人的增值税实际税负较低。进一步研究发现,小规模纳税人为保持现有纳税身份会对应税销售额进行调整,表现为小规模纳税人的产品平均销售价格显著下降、销售量明显减少、账税差异水平提高,即企业会利用降低销售价格、减少销售量和实施财务筹划等方式使其应税销售额符合小规模纳税人认定标准。本文研究结论表明,政府应优化增值税纳税人身份转换制度设计,提高税收征管的效能和精准性,缩小不同类型企业间税负差异以增强经济发展的内生动力。

title: Externalities and the Taxation of Top Earners
title_zh: 外部性与高收入者税收
title_primary: 外部性与高收入者税收
title_secondary: Externalities and the Taxation of Top Earners
authors: Kleven, Henrik
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper characterizes the optimal taxation of top earners in a world with externalities. It develops a reduced-form approach that allows for a flexible relationship between top earnings and the distribution of earnings capacities in the population. The optimal top tax rate is expressed in terms of simple sufficient statistics formulas that depend on the magnitude and distribution of net externalities. In general, externalities that run from top earners to bottom earners have much stronger policy implications than externalities within top earners. The theory is linked to evidence on the externalities of top entrepreneurs and a calibration analysis is provided.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了存在外部性时对高收入者的最优税收政策。研究提出了一种简化形式方法，允许高收入群体收入与人群收入能力分布之间存在灵活关系。最优高收入税率通过简单的充分统计量公式表达，该公式取决于净外部性的规模与分布。一般而言，从高收入者流向低收入者的外部性比高收入群体内部的外部性具有更强的政策含义。本文将理论与顶级企业家外部性的实证证据相联系，并提供了校准分析。

title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
title_zh: 元素周期表的过高特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型的战略矿产
title_primary: 元素周期表的过高特权？地缘经济学、内生中心性与绿色转型的战略矿产
title_secondary: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
authors: Josh Kirk, Evgenia Passari, Hélène Rey
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. Main cuts: removed the redundant "response to a strategic supply cut" phrasing fix (corrected the original "price...response" agreement), trimmed the closing "architecture of," and compressed a few connectors without losing any substantive claim.Please provide a short description (less than 180 characters) of the paper's findings. TThought processThought processCritical-mineral trade has concentrated into a China-centred hub-and-spoke network, giving pricing power: supply shocks raise US/EU prices twice as much as fossil-fuel shocks.
abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国持有的相关储量极少。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成——这是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型对此进行形式化，在该模型中，国家自主选择中心化程度，并证明中心化映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求与边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的商品特定供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美欧消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心化不仅是描述性特征：它创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

title: The Effectiveness of Entry Deregulation: Quasi-experimental Evidence from China’s Export Compulsory Inspection Deregulation
title_zh: 准入放松的有效性：来自中国出口强制检验放松的准实验证据
title_primary: 准入放松的有效性：来自中国出口强制检验放松的准实验证据
title_secondary: The Effectiveness of Entry Deregulation: Quasi-experimental Evidence from China’s Export Compulsory Inspection Deregulation
authors: Zhiqing Yang, Zhiyuan Zhu, Peiyao Liu, Lianfa Luo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: When and how to phase out existing regulations represents a critical policy issue for developing countries. This paper investigates the effects of export inspection deregulation, exploiting the removal of China's compulsory inspection regulation for export commodities as a quasi-experiment. We construct a unique firm-level panel dataset comprising 8700 observations by mapping 10-digit HS product codes to firm identifiers and integrating four distinct micro-databases. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) framework, we find that deregulating export compulsory inspection exerts an overall positive impact on firm exports, without causing a significant decline in export quality as measured by consumer willingness to pay. We also find that inspection deregulation strengthens firms' innovation capacity, which suggests that innovation could be a mechanism that promotes export performance. Furthermore, we find that the effects of export inspection deregulation are stronger in industries characterized by higher levels of competition. Our findings provide empirical evidence for the benefits of periodic regulatory re-evaluation and suggest that well-designed phase-out mechanisms can foster innovation-led growth in emerging economies.
abstract_zh: 何时以及如何逐步取消现有法规，是发展中国家面临的关键政策问题。本文以中国取消出口商品强制检验规定为准自然实验，探究出口检验放松管制的影响。通过将10位HS编码产品映射至企业标识，并整合四个不同的微观数据库，我们构建了一个包含8700个观测值的独特企业层面面板数据集。运用双重差分（DID）框架，我们发现放松出口强制检验对企业出口整体上产生积极影响，且并未导致以消费者支付意愿衡量的出口质量显著下降。同时，检验放松管制增强了企业的创新能力，这表明创新可能是促进出口绩效的一个机制。此外，我们发现出口检验放松管制在竞争程度较高的行业中效果更为显著。我们的研究为定期重新评估法规的益处提供了经验证据，并表明设计良好的退出机制能够促进新兴经济体的创新驱动型增长。

title: How localized differences in street greenery conditions are associated with urban public space use patterns: Evidence from the Las Vegas Strip
title_zh: 街道绿化条件的局部差异如何与城市公共空间使用模式相关联：来自拉斯维加斯大道的证据
title_primary: 街道绿化条件的局部差异如何与城市公共空间使用模式相关联：来自拉斯维加斯大道的证据
title_secondary: How localized differences in street greenery conditions are associated with urban public space use patterns: Evidence from the Las Vegas Strip
authors: Xiaowei Li, Yuhan Wen, Qiuyi Yang, Xiwei Shen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In hot-arid cities, street-level greenery is often introduced with the expectation that it will improve pedestrian comfort, for example by providing shade and moderating local thermal conditions. However, it remains unclear whether street-level greenery meaningfully shapes pedestrian behavior in places where foot traffic is already intense and urban functions are highly concentrated. To address this question, we compare street greenery and hardscape segments along the Las Vegas Strip, one of the world’s most heavily used pedestrian corridors, using commercially collected, anonymized mobile location data from 2020 to 2024. Our analysis proceeds in three connected steps, moving from temporal patterns of pedestrian activity to movement sequences, and finally to identifying locations with high potential for future greening interventions. First, we identify pedestrian stops based on dwell time and summarize pedestrian activity over time to characterize patterns of visitation, time spent, and hourly use. Group comparisons and temporal clustering show that areas with street greenery do not consistently attract more pedestrians overall, but their use shifts over the course of the day, with a larger share of activity occurring at night. Second, reconstructing movement paths and examining the network structure suggests that these behavioral differences do not meaningfully change overall movement patterns along the corridor. Instead, green sites tend to play different directional roles within pedestrian sequences, more often serving as points of origin than destinations, especially at night. Finally, we use supervised learning to identify locations with high potential for future street greenery, drawing on temporal, spatial, and contextual patterns in pedestrian activity. The models highlight spatially coherent areas with higher intervention potential, illustrating how observed pedestrian behavior can be used for exploratory screening of candidate sites. The findings indicate that contrasting localized streetscape conditions are most consistently associated with differences in nighttime activity shares and localized lingering behavior, rather than with higher aggregate pedestrian volume or changes in corridor-wide movement structure. More broadly, the study demonstrates how multi-year mobile location data can support descriptive behavioral mapping and exploratory screening of candidate streetscape improvement zones under shared climatic variability, rather than causal evaluation of greenery impacts.
abstract_zh: 在炎热干旱的城市中，街道绿化常被引入，期望能改善行人舒适度，例如通过提供遮荫和调节局部热环境。然而，在步行交通本就密集且城市功能高度集中的区域，街道绿化是否切实影响行人行为仍不明确。为解答此问题，我们以拉斯维加斯大道——全球使用最频繁的步行走廊之一——为对象，比较其沿线的街道绿化段与硬质景观段，利用2020年至2024年间商业采集的匿名移动位置数据。我们的分析分三个相互关联的步骤展开，从行人活动的时间模式到移动序列，最终识别未来绿化干预的高潜力区域。首先，我们基于停留时间识别行人驻足点，并汇总随时间变化的行人活动，以刻画访问、停留时长及小时使用模式。分组比较和时间聚类显示，街道绿化区域总体上并未持续吸引更多行人，但其使用在一天中有所变化，夜间活动占比更高。其次，重建移动路径并考察网络结构表明，这些行为差异并未显著改变走廊整体的移动模式。相反，绿化地点在行人序列中往往扮演不同的方向性角色，更多作为起点而非终点，尤其在夜间。最后，我们利用监督学习，基于行人活动的时间、空间和情境模式，识别未来街道绿化的高潜力地点。模型突出显示空间连贯且干预潜力较高的区域，展示了如何利用观测到的行人行为进行候选地点的探索性筛选。研究结果表明，局部街道景观条件的对比最一致地与夜间活动份额差异及局部逗留行为相关，而非与更高的总体行人流量或走廊整体移动结构的改变相关。更广泛而言，本研究展示了多年移动位置数据如何在共同气候变异下支持描述性行为映射及候选街道景观改善区域的探索性筛选，而非对绿化影响的因果评估。

title: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
title_zh: 干旱与经济活动：水坝与地下水能否缓解其影响？
title_primary: 干旱与经济活动：水坝与地下水能否缓解其影响？
title_secondary: Droughts and Economic Activity: Do Dams and Groundwater Mediate the Impact?
authors: Sheila M. Olmstead, Hilary Sigman
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the effects of droughts on economic activity, proxied by nighttime lights. Using two different indices of drought severity, one remotely sensed and one from ground-sensed meteorological data, we provide some of the first global estimates of the economic effects of drought, as opposed to temperature and precipitation. Economic impacts depend on drought severity, with moderate-or-worse droughts reducing luminosity by about 2%. Water storage in the form of accessible groundwater mitigates drought impacts. Dams moderate the effects of all but the most extreme droughts. For moderate or worse droughts, negative effects are fully offset by the presence of dams, unless some dams are hydroelectric. Upstream dams do not appear to create harmful spillovers for drought resilience downstream. Results are robust to allowing separate mediating impacts from irrigation and suggest that the resilience benefits of dams and groundwater extend beyond agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本研究以夜间灯光作为经济活动代理变量，考察干旱对经济活动的影响。利用两种干旱严重程度指数——一种基于遥感数据，另一种基于地面气象观测数据——我们提供了全球范围内干旱（而非温度和降水）经济影响的首批估计之一。经济影响取决于干旱严重程度，中度及以上干旱会使夜间灯光亮度降低约2%。以可获取地下水形式存在的水储量能够缓解干旱影响。水坝可减轻除极端干旱外所有干旱的影响。对于中度及以上干旱，除非部分水坝用于水力发电，否则其负面影响可被水坝完全抵消。上游水坝似乎不会对下游抗旱韧性产生有害溢出效应。在允许灌溉产生独立中介效应的条件下，结果依然稳健，并表明水坝和地下水的韧性效益不仅限于农业领域。

title: Cyclical Fluctuations, Financial Frictions, and Productivity Differences across Firms
title_zh: 周期性波动、金融摩擦与企业间生产率差异
title_primary: 周期性波动、金融摩擦与企业间生产率差异
title_secondary: Cyclical Fluctuations, Financial Frictions, and Productivity Differences across Firms
authors: Luca Guerrieri, Jinill Kim, Arsenii Mishin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Within narrowly defined industries, the most productive firms produce far more than the least productive from the same inputs, and this dispersion widens in downturns. We build a tractable representative-agent model in which financial frictions—adverse selection and moral hazard—make firms sort endogenously into lenders, strategic defaulters, and producers. As credit conditions vary, the resulting misallocation gives aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) an endogenous component that accounts for about 30 percent of the variance of TFP at business-cycle frequencies, a third of it from strategic default. We show that our tractable model can match key features of the observed distribution of productivity across firms and its co-movement with output growth and credit conditions in the data.
abstract_zh: 在狭义定义的行业中，最具生产力的企业使用相同投入的产出远高于最低生产力企业，且这种差距在经济下行期进一步扩大。我们构建了一个易于处理的代表性主体模型，其中金融摩擦——逆向选择与道德风险——使企业内生地分化为贷款方、策略性违约方与生产方。随着信贷条件变化，由此产生的资源错配使全要素生产率（TFP）具有内生性成分，该成分解释了商业周期频率下约30%的TFP波动，其中三分之一源于策略性违约。研究表明，我们的可处理模型能够匹配观测到的企业间生产率分布的关键特征，及其与产出增长和信贷条件在数据中的协同变动关系。

title: The Informed Insider: A Leading Measure of Quality
title_zh: 知情内幕者：质量的领先指标
title_primary: 知情内幕者：质量的领先指标
title_secondary: The Informed Insider: A Leading Measure of Quality
authors: Wei Cai, Dennis Campbell, Yaxuan Chen, Yufei Chen, Andrea Prat
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Product and service quality is fundamental to firm value creation, yet it is well recognized as difficult to observe ex ante. Existing quality proxies are limited in coverage, lack cross-firm comparability, and primarily rely on lagging indicators that capture product or service failures only after they materialize. Exploiting employees’ informational advantage as informed insiders and firsthand observers of firms’ internal operations, we develop and validate a novel, forward-looking measure of firm-year-level product and service quality using over 4.3 million employee reviews on Glassdoor. Leveraging machine learning models trained on a subset of firms with third-party customer satisfaction data, we construct quality indices for S&P 1500 firms spanning 2008 to 2023. The resulting quality measures exhibit meaningful variation across firms and within firms over time. In out-of-sample tests, our quality indices demonstrate strong predictive power for future quality provision, emerging as the single most important predictor relative to firm fundamentals and Glassdoor ratings. We validate our measure by examining its association with alternative quality metrics. We show that our quality measures are useful in predicting important quality-related firm outcomes such as product recalls, brand value, and profitability. We also construct an alternative set of quality measures using a zero-shot prompt-based approach and a supervised fine-tuning approach with GPT models to assess the potential of LLMs and generative AI in capturing firm-level quality provision. Our paper shows the value of employee voices as a powerful, forward-looking, and scalable signal of firm quality provision. The paper offers implications for stakeholders seeking to identify quality-related risks and opportunities before they become externally visible.
abstract_zh: 产品和服务质量是企业价值创造的基础，但公认难以事前观察。现有质量代理指标覆盖范围有限、缺乏跨企业可比性，且主要依赖滞后指标——仅在产品或服务失败发生后才能捕捉问题。利用员工作为知情内部人和企业运营一线观察者的信息优势，我们基于Glassdoor平台430余万条员工评价，开发并验证了一种新颖的前瞻性企业年度产品与服务质量衡量指标。通过机器学习模型对部分拥有第三方客户满意度数据的企业进行训练，我们构建了2008年至2023年标普1500指数成分企业的质量指数。由此得出的质量指标在企业间及企业内随时间均呈现显著差异。在样本外测试中，我们的质量指数对未来质量供给展现出强劲预测能力，相较于企业基本面数据和Glassdoor评分，成为最重要的单一预测因子。我们通过检验该指标与其他质量替代指标的相关性进行验证，并证明其能有效预测产品召回、品牌价值及盈利能力等重要质量相关企业结果。我们还采用基于零样本提示的方法和基于GPT模型的监督微调方法构建了替代性质量指标，以评估大语言模型和生成式AI捕捉企业层面质量供给的潜力。本文揭示了员工声音作为企业质量供给的前瞻性、可扩展性强大信号的价值，为利益相关者在质量相关风险与机遇外部显化前进行识别提供了启示。

title: Organized thuggery
title_zh: 有组织的暴行
title_primary: 有组织的暴行
title_secondary: Organized thuggery
authors: Henry A. Thompson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Few mafia traditions have endured as long or been shared as widely as the pizzo . The pizzo was and is a customary payment collected from clients by Italian mafias in exchange for private protection. The value of the pizzo was vulnerable to two sources of dissipation. First, excess competition for clients from other mafiosi . Second, evasive behavior from clients themselves. I argue that Italian mafias created de facto property rights to limit those losses. To limit competition, mafias in Italy defined client ownership via territorial delineation. To limit opportunism by clients, mafias tailored pizzo terms in proportion to clients’ latitude for opportunism. Historical evidence from New York mafias and Italy’s retailing and construction industries supports my thesis.
abstract_zh: 很少有黑手党传统能像“保护费”（pizzo）那样持久且广泛流传。保护费过去是、现在依然是意大利黑手党向客户收取的、以换取私人保护的惯例性费用。保护费的价值面临两种损耗来源：其一，其他黑手党成员对客户的过度竞争；其二，客户自身的规避行为。本文认为，意大利黑手党通过创设事实上的产权来限制这些损失。为限制竞争，意大利黑手党通过地域划分界定客户所有权；为限制客户的投机行为，黑手党根据客户投机行为的空间量身定制保护费条款。来自纽约黑手党以及意大利零售业与建筑业的历史证据支持了本文论点。

title: How education matches occupation: modelling the structure of skill-job alignment
title_zh: 教育如何匹配职业：技能-职位匹配结构的建模
title_primary: 教育如何匹配职业：技能-职位匹配结构的建模
title_secondary: How education matches occupation: modelling the structure of skill-job alignment
authors: Emanuela Ghignoni, Roberto Roson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the relationship between educational attainment and occupations in Italy, focusing on how education aligns with job categories and how this relationship evolves over time. Using Labour Force Survey data, we construct education–occupation matrices for 2014, 2019, and 2024, providing a detailed view of changes in the joint distribution of workers across education and occupations. We introduce a theoretical model in which each education–occupation combination is treated as a labour sub-market, and employment levels result from equilibrium between labour supply and demand. The model provides a structural benchmark to assess whether observed changes can be explained by standard market mechanisms. Comparing observed and predicted matrices over the periods 2014–2019 and 2019–2024, we identify non-negligible deviations from benchmark-consistent reallocation. These deviations are interpreted as signals consistent with structural change in the labour market, potentially reflecting technological developments, institutional factors, or shifts in educational supply. The framework is intended as a diagnostic tool rather than a causal test: deviations between predicted and observed allocations signal unexplained reallocation patterns rather than provide direct evidence on specific underlying mechanisms.

title: Estimating the value of land in Iran’s economy
title_zh: 估算伊朗经济中土地的价值
title_primary: 估算伊朗经济中土地的价值
title_secondary: Estimating the value of land in Iran’s economy
authors: Ensieh Mosaddeghi, Mohammadbagher Asadi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) and the European System of Accounts (ESA), land is classified as a natural resource and a non-produced non-financial asset. Due to its significant share in an economy’s assets, evaluating the value of land is crucial for preparing the national balance sheet and national wealth. This requires classifying land types according to their use and pricing them accordingly. The main types of land include land underlying dwellings, land underlying other buildings and structures, agricultural, and forestry lands. This study estimates the value of land as an economic asset in Iran, providing the first comprehensive evaluation of various land types in the country. Lands underlying dwellings are valued using residual (benchmark approach), net present value (NPV), and land-to-structure ratio (LSR) methods. Lands underlying other buildings and structures are valued using the LSR method, while agricultural and forestry lands are valued based on the NPV of expected future incomes. The results of this study show that the total estimated value of land in Iran ranges from IRR 32,862 trillion to IRR 918,986 trillion during 2015–2023. Lands underlying dwellings constitute the largest share of this value at 45.59%, with the household sector being the largest owner. Agricultural lands have the second-largest share, followed by land underlying buildings other than dwellings (on average, approximately 32.66% and 21.56%, respectively), while forest lands have the smallest share of the total land value (on average 0.19%).
abstract_zh: 根据国民账户体系（SNA）与欧洲账户体系（ESA），土地被归类为自然资源及非生产性非金融资产。鉴于土地在经济体资产中占据重要份额，评估土地价值对于编制国家资产负债表和国家财富至关重要。这要求根据土地用途对其类型进行分类，并据此定价。主要土地类型包括住宅用地、其他建筑物和构筑物用地、农业用地及林业用地。本研究估算了伊朗作为经济资产的土地价值，首次对该国各类土地进行了全面评估。住宅用地采用剩余法（基准法）、净现值法（NPV）及土地与建筑物比率法（LSR）进行估值；其他建筑物和构筑物用地采用LSR法估值；农业和林业用地则基于预期未来收入的净现值进行估值。研究结果显示，2015年至2023年间，伊朗土地总价值估计介于32,862万亿伊朗里亚尔至918,986万亿伊朗里亚尔之间。其中，住宅用地占总价值的最大份额，为45.59%，住户部门是最大的所有者。农业用地占比次之，其后依次为除住宅外的建筑物用地（平均分别约为32.66%和21.56%），而林业用地在土地总价值中占比最小（平均为0.19%）。

title: Medical innovation and health disparities
title_zh: 医学创新与健康差距
title_primary: 医学创新与健康差距
title_secondary: Medical innovation and health disparities
authors: Barton H. Hamilton, Andrés Hincapié, Emma C. Kalish, Nicholas W. Papageorge
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A long-standing question in health economics asks what drives heterogeneity in health investments across sociodemographic groups, which contribute to health disparities. We examine a novel source: variation by sociodemographic groups in the impact of medical treatment side effects. We estimate a lifecycle model of medication and labor supply decisions using data on men infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and with different levels of completed education. Agents in the model make dynamic medication and work choices as a function of expected income, health, and mortality. We also include utility costs of side effects, which can interact with the utility cost of work, and allow these parameters to vary by education. We use the estimated model to evaluate the disparate impacts of an effective HIV treatment innovation that had harsh side effects: HAART (which stands for highly active antiretroviral treatment). Measured in lifetime utility gains, HAART disproportionately benefited patients with more education in part due to differences in income and mortality, but also due to smaller impacts of side effects on labor supply. We also simulate the effects of a HAART treatment mandate, which mimics assignment to treatment in a clinical trial. The mandate improves health, which might be viewed as a success in a randomized trial. However, this masks the downsides of treatment, including lower labor supply due to side effects, especially for lower-education men. Broadly, viewing heterogeneity in health investments as solely a result of barriers to access is overly simplistic. Individually optimal investments in health may in part reflect the costs of managing side effects and work. If low health investments create negative externalities (e.g., due to increased use of publicly-funded healthcare), the benefits of policies that moderate resulting health-work tradeoffs could outweigh the costs.
abstract_zh: 健康经济学中一个长期存在的问题是，什么因素导致了不同社会人口群体在健康投资上的异质性，这种异质性进而加剧了健康差距。我们考察了一个新的来源：社会人口群体在医疗治疗副作用影响上的差异。我们利用感染人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）且教育程度不同的男性数据，估计了一个关于服药和劳动供给决策的生命周期模型。模型中的个体根据预期收入、健康状况和死亡率做出动态的服药与工作选择。我们还将副作用的效用成本纳入模型，这些成本可能与工作的效用成本相互作用，并允许这些参数因教育程度而异。我们利用估计的模型评估了一种具有严重副作用的有效HIV治疗创新——HAART（即高效抗逆转录病毒治疗）——对不同群体的差异化影响。以终身效用增益衡量，HAART不成比例地惠及教育程度较高的患者，部分原因在于收入和死亡率的差异，但也因为副作用对劳动供给的影响较小。我们还模拟了HAART治疗强制实施的效果，这类似于临床试验中的治疗分配。强制实施改善了健康状况，这在随机试验中可能被视为成功。然而，这掩盖了治疗的负面影响，包括因副作用导致的劳动供给下降，尤其是对教育程度较低的男性而言。总体来看，将健康投资的异质性仅仅视为获取障碍的结果是过于简单化的。个体最优的健康投资可能部分反映了管理副作用和工作的成本。如果低健康投资产生负外部性（例如，由于公共资助医疗服务的增加使用），那么调节由此产生的健康与工作权衡的政策的收益可能超过其成本。

title: An experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game
title_zh: 多期选美竞赛博弈实验研究
title_primary: 多期选美竞赛博弈实验研究
title_secondary: An experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game
authors: Nobuyuki Hanaki, Yuta Takahashi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present and conduct a novel experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game. Leveraging the multi-period feature, we investigate how participants revise their forecasts in periods when new information—such as shocks or announcements—arrives and how they form their expectations in the absence of new information. We make two key contributions. First, we develop a new method based on forecast revisions to evaluate whether participants behave in a forward-looking manner. The experimental results show that participants do react to anticipated shocks: namely, the announcements of future shocks. Second, we identify a new strategic environment effect during periods without new information; only when the game exhibits strategic complementarity do participants use extrapolation and expect continuously rising prices. This finding suggests that expectation formation is endogenous to the economic environment; and policy design should thus take this endogeneity into account.
abstract_zh: 我们设计并开展了一项关于多期选美比赛博弈的新实验。利用多期特征，我们研究了参与者在信息更新时期（如冲击或公告发布时）如何修正其预测，以及在缺乏新信息时如何形成预期。本研究有两项核心贡献：第一，我们基于预测修正开发了一种新方法，用以评估参与者是否具有前瞻性行为。实验结果表明，参与者确实会对预期冲击（即未来冲击的公告）做出反应；第二，我们发现在无新信息时期存在一种新的战略环境效应——只有当博弈呈现战略互补性时，参与者才会采用外推法并预期价格持续上涨。这一发现表明，预期形成内生于经济环境，因此政策设计应考虑这种内生性。

title: Market visualizations
title_zh: 市场可视化
title_primary: 市场可视化
title_secondary: Market visualizations
authors: Daniel Friedman, Brett Williams, Vivian Juehui Zheng
official: 官方在线 2026-05-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In a $k$ -replica Edgeworth box economy, we compare outcomes of laboratory markets in which human traders have different visualizations available on their screens. Novel visualizations include a heat map that shows at a glance the value of all feasible portfolios (i.e., final allocations); a geometric display of the order book; and order entry via point-and-click on the heat map. Efficiency metrics focus on allocations, prices and profitability. Compared to the traditional text-oriented trader screen for the continuous double auction, we find that the novel features generally increase all three efficiency metrics.
abstract_zh: 在一个$k$重复埃奇沃思盒经济中，我们比较了人类交易者在屏幕上拥有不同可视化选项的实验室市场结果。新颖的可视化功能包括：热力图，可一目了然地显示所有可行投资组合（即最终配置）的价值；订单簿的几何展示；以及通过点击热力图进行订单输入。效率指标侧重于配置、价格和盈利能力。与传统的面向文本的连续双向拍卖交易屏幕相比，我们发现新颖功能通常能提升所有三项效率指标。
